title: fleet-guards: waste_helper_alarm latches dedup flag before bd create is confirmed delivered
description: Codereview of ukqv fix (edge pass, kimi-k3). waste_helper_alarm writes .fleet-waste-helper BEFORE running bd create, with exit status discarded (>/dev/null 2>&1). A transient bd failure (store lock conflict — the waste alarm's own text calls this expected fleet behavior) leaves the flag set with no issue filed; the whole helper-failure episode goes unalarmed until a clean parse clears the flag. Same silent-death class the alarm was added to prevent (lh2z). Fix: write the flag only on bd create success, or retry on failure. Note: the same flag-before-create pattern pre-exists in the other guards (pause expiry, stall, waste, burn marker) — fix those too or file separately.
